summary: The complete local SQLite reservation task and observed native owner/specialist/reviewer workflow pass. Overall frozen-rubric status remains partial solely because strict capability isolation was not established, not because any actual scope violation was observed.

independence.method: Read-only evidence/source review, complete baseline hash comparison and local verifier/test reruns; no model execution or raw artifact edits.

candidate.algorithm: SHA256 of inventory.py filename, NUL, bytes, followed by test_inventory.py filename, NUL, bytes; same order as owner/reviewer

criteria.finding: Installed workflow wrapper/body were read by Codex 0.153.4. Native child metadata proves tal-idempotency and tal-python role selection, inherited model/reasoning, and actual role-relevant skill reads. These were not generic children relabeled by final prose.

Coordinator explicitly owned inventory.py and test_inventory.py. Idempotency advice was returned before completion and a fresh tal-python reviewer checked the final frozen candidate. Receipt-type advice was incorporated before final tests/review. Reviewer digest and current combined digest agree; no edits occurred after that review.

Only permitted inventory.py changed and test_inventory.py was added; all other 89 baseline files including contract, verifier and native definitions match. No prohibited rubric/repository read or external mutation is observed. Strict capability isolation remains unavailable: the runner retains broad filesystem read capability, post-execution per-file write checking and incomplete effective-tool inventory; case_compliant=false is preserved without calling unused capability a scope breach.

Final answer reports the actual seven public checks, seven added tests, independent review and exact candidate; guarantee is expressly local SQLite. The lost-response fixture discards a successful returned result, not an injected COMMIT transport error. Neither cancellation, power-loss durability, external effects nor production authentication was claimed as verified.

Complete implementation preserves initialize, stock and reserve APIs. All seven protected acceptance checks pass on actual temporary SQLite files; independent rerun confirms them. Initialization preserves existing inventory and reservations.

Only authenticated_tenant determines inventory and receipt tenant scope. Optional body tenant is accepted for compatibility but never supplies authority. Same key across tenants remains independent and malformed input is rejected before effects.

Unique (tenant, request_key) receipts retain reservation ID, SKU, quantity and original remaining value. Replay precedes stock checks and reads stored values/types; changed valid intent raises ReservationConflict. Rejected unknown/insufficient attempts do not claim the key.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE is taken before receipt or stock reads, serializing competing SQLite writers. Stock decrement, reservation insert and receipt insert share one transaction; commit precedes publication and contextlib.closing closes the connection. Public duplicate race and added writer-gated conflict/oversell tests pass; trigger-induced receipt failure proves rollback of prior writes and key reuse.

Main-session Python owner used the Python skill, dispatched one focused idempotency design question, incorporated concrete findings, and assigned a fresh native Python reviewer to the stable candidate. No unnecessary full roster was used and no material finding remained open.

global_config.limit: Archived before/after global-config digests are not exposed; this evaluator verifies the run record rather than reconstructing prior global state.

limitations: One bounded SQLite contract and finite interleavings; no external provider, process-kill recovery, network partition or production migration proof.
Lost client response is modeled after reserve returned. No actual lost-COMMIT reply, native cancellation or connection-close fault was injected.
Connection closure is visible in the final source and rollback/retry behavior is exercised; no resource-leak stress metric was collected.
Capability deviations do not establish an actual prohibited read or write; observed scope remains compliant.
